pages.text: $(bold)Venus — The Acid World$(/bold)$(br)Difficulty: $(bold)10.0x$(/bold) (beyond Dragon's Domain)$(br)Death Penalty: $(bold)28%$(/bold)$(br2)The most hostile inner planet. Venus's crushing pressure and acid atmosphere make every moment on the surface a fight for survival. Mobs here are pressure-adapted and acid-resistant.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$(/bold)$(br)• $(bold)Acid rain$(/bold) deals continuous damage — no escape on the surface$(br)• $(bold)Crushing pressure$(/bold) reduces movement speed significantly$(br)• Acid-resistant mobs gain Resistance and Strength$(br2)Venus is designed to be short, intense expeditions. Get in, mine what you need, get out. Extended stays will drain your resources rapidly.

$(bold)Purpose$(/bold)$(br)Venus contains high-value ores required for the $(bold)Tier 4 Rocket$(/bold) to reach Glacio — the true endgame destination.$(br2)$(bold)Structures$(/bold)$(br)Floating cloud structures above the acid layer and deep surface bunkers contain unique loot. The floating structures are safer to explore but harder to reach.
